evidence_quotes.their_agenda: What are your biggest concerns or what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today, aside from the rate the pricing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer stated concern about quality and attention to detail. Rep acknowledged with 'Well basically Einstein is the perfect perfect fit for you' and pivoted to damage coverage rather than probing deeper (e.g., 'tell me more about what careful handling looks like to you').
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Rep said 'your items are very important and we'll make sure that they will be delivered safely' — acknowledges but does not reflect back the stated concerns as a summary check.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: No pricing discussion occurred; call routed to walkthrough scheduler before any estimate was given.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: No explicit ask for business; call ended with 'please expect a callback from Serg' and confirmation of callback number.

top_strength: Rep correctly identified a 2,400 sq ft move as a large move requiring a virtual walkthrough and cleanly routed the call to Sergio without abandoning the customer or leaving loose ends.
coaching_note: When the customer stated their concern about quality and careful handling, rep jumped to damage coverage framing instead of asking 'tell me more about that' — missing the chance to deepen understanding before the handoff and build more trust before transfer.
